defects.description: PR-v3 systematic spine-sign audit missed this pose. Description: leaning the torso BACK to rest against a higher wall behind you — explicit backward arch / back-on-wall posture. spine=12 is positive (forward fold per CORRECTED convention). Should be spine negative (backward arch). Same pattern as PR-v3 fixes for back-wall-prop, car-lean, gate-lean (all "back against" / "torso back" language).

Description: feet planted on the ground. Currently L foot y=-0.322, R foot y=-0.308 (both elevated; planted threshold y<-0.7). Rig constraint: hips fixed at y=0.12, deep knee flexion (85deg) brings feet forward not down — geometrically cannot reach y<-0.7 without major rework. Acknowledged as rig limit.

regression_risk: low — single field change, only flips torso lean direction to match description
rationale: Single-field spine sign fix. PR-v3 missed low-wall-sit despite identical "torso back against wall" language to back-wall-prop/car-lean/gate-lean which PR-v3 fixed. Flipping 12→-14 to match backward-arch posture. Hands-on-ledge-beside-hips not achieved (L wrist→L hip dist2D=0.45, R wrist→R hip dist2D=0.32) — rig constraint similar to hip-lean: shoulder abduction geometry cannot bring wrist to hip horizontally without breaking arm at-side posture; deferred. Knee flexion (85/85) for perch + ankles (-15/-15) preserved. Hips=10 mild list preserved.
